title: Kong Operator 2.4 adds self-managed AI and Event Gateway support
summary: The Kubernetes operator now supports self-managed AI and Event Gateway deployments. That expands the addressable deployment options for organizations with data-residency or network-isolation requirements, but the release does not quantify paid adoption or revenue. Maintain the investment thesis and valuation assumptions.
confirmed: Kong announced general availability of Operator 2.4 on November 24, 2026.
The operator can configure on-premises AI Gateway without a Konnect-hosted control plane and adds on-premises Event Gateway support.
Kong reported that Operator reached the conformant category in the upstream Kubernetes Gateway API implementation list.
uncertain: No paid customer count, adoption, incremental revenue, margin, or IPO evidence was disclosed.
Whether self-managed deployments add net new sales or substitute for hosted usage is unverified.
